name: Visionn

sample.title: THIS IS NOT A BAD APP
sample.text: So what I will say about this application is that I feel as though you get what you pay for. It will do what it says. My expectations coming into using this app were somewhat his and I personally was a little disappointed with the results. But before I ran here to leave a bad review or bash on the people who programmed it, I reflected and thought for a second. The 2 dollars that I spent on this app gave me 2 dollar quality results. And for that I cannot be mad because again, I got what I paid for. Not I think that they can improve this greatly. Firstly improve the quality of the ‘paint/art’ picture quality. If that’s some then I think that’s solve a LOT of issue.

sample.title: Can’t find these effects anywhere else
sample.text: Sometimes, I’m looking for a special something to put the defining mark on a project, and Visionn can do it when other apps feel kind of homogenized. It’s fun. I just wish there were glide bars to ease back on an effect occasionally. Overall, it’s a great find.

sample.title: Wonderful App!
sample.text: I really been having fun with this app! Initially had some issues with crashing but it seems like they have fixed that, and dropped some more great filter effects.  Unlike most other basic editing apps it does some beautiful real time effects on video (with the option for photos as well). I've been having fun throwing these on videos I've been shooting on my iPhone and GoPro.  Keep up the great stuff!

sample.title: Very cool and simple app but....
sample.text: I really like the simplicity and although there are only a few filters they are really great. Only issue I have is all the videos have this weird black box thing that glitches in and out all over the video. This doesn’t show in their App Store video so I’m wondering how it can be turned off or if it’s just that....a glitch. Unfortunately that makes it unusable . Maybe I’m missing something and the devs can help here?

sample.title: Some cool features, but disappointed
sample.text: I was looking for an app to make cool animated pictures. It does that for the most part, but the pictures end up turning out blurry and not high quality at all. I wish there was a way to adjust how much of the filter you want to put on one picture. I was also kind of disappointed with the lack of other filters they had and the ability to adjust those. Was it worth $2 not really!

sample.title: Fantastic
sample.text: This is an excellent phone editing app. It does artistic touch is better than anything I can think of. There are a dozen or so, and I think there’s probably something for almost everyone. Burnside, Monte Villa, and Belmont are always perfect.

sample.title: Love this app
sample.text: I was so bummed when I realized my “Philm” app was no longer, but then I found this app. I love the artistic effects to my photos.  For future updates, it would be cool to have a few  filters that have more color.

sample.title: Photo to Art
sample.text: I love this app. It's very simple to use, but only has a handful of filters. I play with it for a few days, then forget about it for awhile, and am super excited when I go back to it. It's perfect for making your photos look like paintings.

sample.title: Great stuff!
sample.text: Hi guys, I looove this product! Use it on a daily basis. I’ve noticed though that when I try to post slow motion videos, it doesn’t work. I just get the message “preparing slow-mo...”. Might there be an update to fix this issue? I’d truly do stand by this product!De’Eric

sample.title: Terrific App
sample.text: It is a quick, solid, as advertised graphic program that is easy and fun. The choice ways to modify your photos are all quite different and effective. It's hard to pick which ones I like to use the most. Nice job, guys.

sample_note: These are the reviews Apple shows on the App Store page: chosen by Apple, some years old. Apple's review feed has returned empty lists for every app since 27 Nov 2026, so this app gets the full analysis when it returns.
